answer: Locks are entered in cipher, expire in prism, and oasis lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 87 aliases thus needs 188 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1231 identities would post 3589 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
